purpose: T=3.2 shifted phonon trial stationarity only; no T=6.4, Hamiltonian/trial/estimator changes or physical interpretation

not_ready_if: any of six targeted half-chain differences is >3 of its diagnostic SE, even if isolated (then unresolved, not proven drift)
same-sign half-chain difference >2 diagnostic SE in two or more new chains for the same observable
first-versus-fourth-quarter difference >3 diagnostic SE for a targeted observable, or same-sign >2 diagnostic SE in two or more chains (quarters are screening only)
two or more between-chain comparisons on the same observable have simultaneous six-observable 95-percent intervals excluding zero
SE at 400 sweeps exceeds 1.5 times its 200-sweep value for two or more targeted observables
phase unresolved or any numerical failure
stationarity_screen_fixed_before_results.multiple_comparisons_and_autocorrelation: Screen thresholds are conservative decisions, not calibrated familywise hypothesis tests. Half/quarter diagnostic SEs omit boundary covariance. Consider collective direction, blocks and between-chain consistency; absence of a trigger is only practical readiness, not proof of independence.

stop: exactly four new chains; do not extend budget based on intermediate or final results
